description: This file defines the OrganizationService class with methods to fetch organization details from an API and check if code indexing is enabled for an organization.

classes.name: OrganizationService
classes.description: Service class for fetching and managing Kilo Code organization settings

methods.name: fetchOrganization
methods.description: Fetches organization details from the Kilo Code API using provided token and organization ID, with optional tester warnings suppression.

methods.name: isCodeIndexingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if code indexing is enabled for a given organization object, defaults to false if not specified.
